children: American Tower entered into an Indenture to issue three tranches of senior unsecured notes totaling $1.6 billion in net proceeds. The company sold $500 million of 5.300% notes due 2031, $500 million of 5.560% notes due 2033, and $600 million of 5.750% notes due 2036. Proceeds will be used to repay $600 million of 1.450% notes due 2026, reduce borrowings under its $6.0 billion revolving credit facility, and for general corporate purposes.
: Indenture for senior unsecured notes due 2031, 2033 and 2036
: U.S. Bank Trust Company, as trustee
: Refinance notes and repay revolver borrowings

title: American Tower Raises $1.6 Billion in 2031–2036 Senior Notes to Refinance Debt
